column1: # .planning/decisions/003-tag-delete-list.tsv — the explicit tag delete-set for ADR 003
# Phase 238 deletes the non-SemVer planning tags that ADR 003 forbids. The delete set can
# never be a glob: `v1.4*` matches BOTH `v1.4` (a planning tag, deleted here) and `v1.4.0`
# (a three-component SemVer tag that backs a published GitHub Release and a published Hex
# package). A prefix expansion at a delete call site would destroy a release-backing tag.
# So the set is enumerated here, one row per tag, reviewed in the same diff as the script
# that consumes it. Prose is a RENDERER of this file, not a second source of truth: the
# runbook and the ADR amendment cite this path rather than restating the set.
# Two namespaces are kept and are handled by EXCLUSION, never by a row here:
#     (the optional prerelease/build suffix is deliberate: the release automation may mint
#      a release-candidate tag during this phase's window — see 238-CONTEXT D-05)
# A row matching either expression is a bug, and scripts/maintainers/delete-planning-tags.sh
# plus this plan's verification both reject it.
#   - scripts/maintainers/delete-planning-tags.sh   the only executor of this set; reads
#                                                   one literal tag name per delete
#                                                   cites this path in its amendment; the
#                                                   and the citation must still resolve
#                                                   phase-proof tags are held by a branch
#                                                   so this column names every object
#   tag             the literal ref name under refs/tags, exactly as passed to one delete
#   local           yes|no — present in `git tag` at capture time
#   remote          yes|no — present in `git ls-remote --tags origin` at capture time.
#                   Independent of `local`: the two sets differ, and a remote delete of a
#                   local-only tag ERRORS, so the remote pass is driven by remote=yes only.
#   pre_delete_sha  the COMMIT this tag resolves to, captured before any deletion
#   reason          why this tag is in the delete set
# Every one of the rows below is an ANNOTATED tag, so %(objectname) is a tag object and
# %(*objectname) is the commit it wraps. `pre_delete_sha` carries the COMMIT — that is the
# object Phase 245 must keep reachable. The tag-object names are recorded here so that
# information is not lost with the refs:
# CAPTURED: 2026-09-17, from the live repository and the live origin.
